exercise.name: Barbell bench press
exercise.equipment: Olympic half rack, Olympic bar, plates, flat bench, safety arms
cues: Eyes under the bar, shoulder blades set, feet planted; unrack with straight arms.
Lower to mid/lower chest with forearms near vertical; touch, then press without bouncing.
Set the half-rack safety arms just below your lowest point and test them with the empty bar. Training alone: safeties every set, and end the set before a grinding rep.
Stop for shoulder pain or losing bar control.

alternative.name: Smith flat bench press
alternative.note: Same sets, RIR and rest. Learn the hooks and test the stops with a light load. Never assume the unloaded Smith bar weighs 20 kg or convert it to free-bar load.

exercise.name: Fixed-handle pull-up or chin-up
cues: Use fixed overhead grips, never a moving cable arm. Choose a comfortable grip supported by the handles; do not force an underhand wrist position.
Brace from a comfortable overhead position, pull elbows toward ribs and lower under control.
Stop before kipping, craning the neck or losing controlled lowering. No weight belt or uncontrolled jumping negatives.

alternative.name: UNICA lat pulldown
alternative.note: Use if five clean pull-ups are unavailable; same sets, RIR and rest. Lat bar on the high hook, thighs braced under the pads; pull to the upper chest without leaning back.

exercise.name: T-bar row (landmine)
exercise.equipment: Olympic bar with one end anchored, plates on the free end, V-grip or hands on the bar
cues: Anchor the bar end so it cannot slide; straddle the bar and hold it close to the plates.
Hinge to a flat back, chest up; row to the lower chest and lower under control.
Stop when the torso starts jerking up to move the weight.

alternative.name: UNICA seated row
alternative.note: Same sets, RIR and rest. Chest against the pad, row the long bars to the stomach.

exercise.name: Seated DB shoulder press
exercise.equipment: DB pair, locked nearly upright bench
cues: Lock backrest nearly upright, plant feet and keep ribs controlled.
Press from a comfortable shoulder-level start along a natural arc; a neutral/semi-neutral grip is acceptable.
Stop for excessive back arch, pain or inability to return DBs safely.

alternative.name: One-arm standing cable press on an upward path
alternative.note: Same sets, RIR and rest. Set D-handle below shoulder level, face away in a staggered stance and press upward/forward without twisting. Reduce load if unstable or the cable contacts you.

exercise.name: DB lateral raise
cues: Stand tall with soft elbows; raise slightly forward of your sides toward shoulder height, then lower slowly.
Allow comfortable individual shoulder motion; stop before shrugging, swinging or heaving takes over.
Start at the lightest setting; add reps before weight.
After the intro phase, take the last set to 0–1 RIR.

alternative.name: One-arm low-cable lateral raise
alternative.note: Same sets, RIR and rest. Low pulley, D-handle in outside hand, standing side-on; use a comfortable arc without leaning for momentum. Stop if the cable path is awkward.

exercise.name: UNICA arm curl
cues: Set the handles, sit close with legs wrapped under the frame and elbows on the pad.
Lower until the arms are fully straight, then curl without lifting the elbows.
Superset with the triceps extension: one set of each, then rest.
After the intro phase, take the last set to 0–1 RIR.

alternative.name: Standing DB curl
alternative.note: Same sets, RIR and rest. Upper arms still, no hip drive.

exercise.name: One-arm cable overhead triceps extension
exercise.equipment: Cable column, D-handle, low or middle pulley
cues: Face away from the pulley in a staggered stance, D-handle behind your head, elbow pointing up.
Let the elbow bend fully for the stretch, then extend without the upper arm drifting.
Superset with the arm curl: one set of each, then rest.
Complete both sides for one set. Start with the weaker side and match clean reps; allow 20–30 seconds to switch sides, then take the listed rest.
Start at the lightest setting; add reps before weight.
After the intro phase, take the last set to 0–1 RIR.

alternative.name: One-DB two-hand overhead extension
alternative.note: Same sets, RIR and rest. Hold one DB securely in both hands overhead and extend from a deep, comfortable elbow bend.

exercise.name: Barbell deadlift
exercise.equipment: Olympic bar, urethane plates, floor or rack pins
cues: Bar over mid-foot, shins near the bar; grip just outside the legs.
Brace, pull the slack out, then push the floor away with the bar dragging up the legs.
Reset each rep; stop if the lower back rounds or the bar drifts forward.

alternative.name: Smith Romanian deadlift
alternative.note: Same sets, RIR and rest. Controlled hinge, stops below the bottom position. Learn the hooks and test the stops with a light load. Never assume the unloaded Smith bar weighs 20 kg or convert it to free-bar load.

exercise.name: Paused barbell squat (2 s)
exercise.equipment: Olympic half rack, Olympic bar, plates, safety arms
cues: Lighter than your heavy squat day. Descend under control and hold the bottom for 2 seconds, still braced.
Drive up from a dead stop; no bounce.
Set the half-rack safety arms just below your lowest point and test them with the empty bar. Training alone: safeties every set, and end the set before a grinding rep.

alternative.name: Paused Smith squat
alternative.note: Same sets, RIR, rest and 2 s pause. Learn the hooks and test the stops with a light load. Never assume the unloaded Smith bar weighs 20 kg or convert it to free-bar load.

exercise.name: Seated leg curl
exercise.equipment: Technogym Selection 700 Dual Leg Curl/Extension, curl mode
cues: Knee lined up with the pivot, thigh pad snug, lean slightly forward to stretch the hamstrings.
Curl as far as you can, then return slowly to straight legs.
Stop for cramping or hips lifting.
After the intro phase, take the last set to 0–1 RIR.

alternative.name: Standing one-leg cable curl
alternative.note: Same sets, RIR and rest. Ankle strap on the low pulley, face the column holding the frame; curl the heel up without the hip moving.

exercise.name: DB stationary split squat, rear foot on floor
cues: Keep both feet on the floor in a stable staggered stance; no rear-foot platform is needed.
Lower straight down through comfortable front-knee/hip range and drive through front foot. Knee travel over toes is normal; avoid tightrope stance.
Stop for balance loss or rear-leg pushing dominating.
Complete both sides for one set. Start with the weaker side and match clean reps; allow 20–30 seconds to switch sides, then take the listed rest.

alternative.name: Smith squat
alternative.note: Same sets, RIR and rest. Use plates and safeties, test hooks/stops and adjust feet to the fixed path; keep whole feet planted and trunk controlled. No rear-foot platform is needed.

exercise.name: Seated DB calf raise
exercise.equipment: Locked bench, DBs on thighs, floor
cues: Sit on locked bench with knees about 90°. Place manageable DBs securely on distal thighs above knees, never on kneecaps.
Raise heels through forefeet, pause and lower to floor; remove DBs safely after the set.
Stop if load slides, setup hurts or bouncing replaces control.
After the intro phase, take the last set to 0–1 RIR.

alternative.name: Supported single-leg standing DB calf raise
alternative.note: Same sets, RIR and rest; not identical knee-angle emphasis. One DB, fixed upright for balance, floor; mostly straight knee, controlled rise and lowering without bouncing or a loose-plate platform.

exercise.name: One-arm cable anti-rotation press
cues: Stand side-on to the pulley, D-handle at the sternum, feet a little wider than hips.
Press straight out and back without letting the cable turn your torso.
Stop when the torso turns or the shoulder is pulled uncomfortably.
Complete both sides for one set. Start with the weaker side and match clean reps; allow 20–30 seconds to switch sides, then take the listed rest.

alternative.name: DB suitcase hold
alternative.note: Same sets and rest. Stand tall holding one heavy DB at your side without leaning toward it.
